name: smwmusic-actraiser-sky-palace-chrono-trigger-styled
title: ActRaiser - Sky Palace (Chrono Trigger Styled)
description:
A slightly altered version of the Sky Palace theme from ActRaiser, used in "ooooo" just before you fight the final boss. This one uses the organs from Chrono Trigger, panning the channels out, and increasing the echo by a lot.

The original sounded tense, and this one steps it up.
If you prefer the original, you may find it here.
